name: Emergency Response Support System (112)
purpose: Emergency response (police, fire, ambulance). Use for immediate danger or threats of physical harm.
whenToUse: Immediate danger to your safety, threats of physical violence, or immediate crisis.
doesNotCover: Not for non-urgent reporting; no response-time promise.

name: Childline (1098)
purpose: Free 24-hour helpline for children in need of care and protection. Use if under 18 or unsure and want to talk to someone trained.
whenToUse: You may be under 18, unsure of your options, or need confidential guidance from trained counsellors.
doesNotCover: The government is integrating it with 112; the number is reported to remain active; no outcome promised.
verificationSource: india.gov.in directory; Lok Sabha answer of 29 Nov 2024

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
purpose: Government of India portal to report cybercrime online, with special focus on crimes against women and children.
whenToUse: Use to prepare and file an official online cybercrime complaint with law enforcement.
doesNotCover: Does not file anything by opening; outcomes and timelines are not guaranteed; do not assume anonymity or confidentiality — check the portal's own information; guides report separate routes for women/child-related and other cybercrime — confirm on the portal.
verificationSource: Kerala Police notice on the portal and 1930; route names from secondary guides

name: National Cyber Crime Helpline (1930)
purpose: National cybercrime helpline linked to the portal, listed as available 24 hours; mainly used for online financial fraud.
whenToUse: Use ONLY if money has already been sent (UPI, bank, card, wallet) because of threats, or a payment is in progress; also tell your bank or payment app.
doesNotCover: Not a general sextortion or image-removal helpline; cannot promise recovery of money.

name: StopNCII.org
purpose: Free tool, for people 18+ (or images taken when 18+), that makes a digital fingerprint on your own device so participating platforms can detect and remove matching images; the image is not uploaded.
whenToUse: Intimate images of you exist and may be shared, or have been threatened to be shared on participating platforms.
doesNotCover: Works only on participating platforms; does not cover the whole internet; keep your case number and PIN; SafeSignal never handles the images.

name: Take It Down (NCMEC)
purpose: Free NCMEC service for images or videos taken when under 18; only a fingerprint is shared, the image stays on your device.
whenToUse: Nude, sexual, or intimate images or videos were taken when you were under 18, and someone is threatening to share them.
doesNotCover: Participating public or unencrypted platforms only; run by a US non-profit, confirm it suits your situation; ideally use with a trusted adult or Childline.

name: Meta Intimate Images Support
purpose: Meta's page on sextortion and intimate-image abuse and how to report threats and images shared without permission on Instagram, Facebook and Messenger.
whenToUse: Threats, blackmail, or image abuse taking place on Meta platforms (Instagram, Facebook, Messenger).
